title: Pure Dual Avatar
summary: Pure Dual Avatar Fusion and self-destruction strategy inspired by martial arts spirituality, featuring the dual paths of Yuhi and Kokoku. By generating Spirit Tokens with Dual Avatar Invitation and destroying your own monsters with Spells and Traps, the deck Fusion Summons Empowered bosses like Dual Avatar - Manifested A-Un to shut down opposing combat and negate Extra Deck monsters.

summary.title: Starters
points: Perfect Sync - A-Un searches any Dual Avatar monster upon activation, and generates a Dual Avatar Spirit Token whenever a Dual Avatar monster you control is destroyed or during your Main Phase.
Dual Avatar Invitation discards 1 card to Special Summon as many Dual Avatar Spirit Tokens as possible, then immediately performs up to two Dual Avatar Fusion Summons in sequence.
Dual Avatar Fists - Yuhi targets and destroys a Dual Avatar monster you control to search any Dual Avatar Spell from Deck to hand, and recurs itself from the GY.
Dual Avatar Feet - Kokoku on Normal Summon searches any Dual Avatar Trap from Deck to hand, and Special Summons itself from hand when a Dual Avatar falls on the opponent's turn.

summary.title: Opening: Dual Avatar Invitation + Dual Avatar Fists - Yuhi
steps: Normal Summon Dual Avatar Fists - Yuhi and activate its effect, destroying itself to search Dual Avatar Invitation (or Perfect Sync - A-Un) from your Deck.
Activate Perfect Sync - A-Un to search Dual Avatar Feet - Kokoku from your Deck.
Activate Dual Avatar Invitation, discarding a card to Special Summon up to 5 Dual Avatar Spirit Tokens.
Use Invitation's effect to Fusion Summon Dual Avatar Feet - Armored Un-Gyo using two Tokens, and Fusion Summon Dual Avatar - Empowered Mitsu-Jaku using Kokoku and Tokens.
Invitation locks your Extra Deck into Fusion Monsters for the rest of the turn.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Dual Avatar - Manifested A-Un gains the continuous and activated effects of the Empowered Dual Avatar Fusions used as its material, combining multiple layers of disruption.
Dual Avatar - Empowered Mitsu-Jaku returns all opponent Spells and Traps to the hand, and destroys an opponent's monster as a Quick Effect during their turn if summoned using an Effect Monster.
Dual Avatar - Empowered Kon-Gyo prevents the opponent from activating cards or effects during the Battle Phase when your Dual Avatar battles, and bounces an opponent's card after attacking.
Dual Avatar Feet - Armored Un-Gyo protects your Dual Avatar Fusions from destruction by card effects and negates the activated effect of an opponent's monster summoned from the Extra Deck.
Dual Avatar Fists - Armored Ah-Gyo destroys an Attack Position monster the opponent controls when Special Summoned.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Dual Avatar Defeating Evil is a Quick-Play Spell that destroys a Dual Avatar monster you control and an opponent's card, then draws 1 card or banishes a card from their GY if an Empowered Fusion was destroyed.
Dual Avatar Ascendance destroys 1 Dual Avatar monster you control to Special Summon a Dual Avatar from your Deck or Extra Deck whose original Level is 1 higher or lower.
Dual Avatar Return revives a Dual Avatar monster from your GY and Special Summons a Spirit Token.
Dual Avatar Compact banishes a Dual Avatar Spell/Trap from your GY to apply its effect.

Searches a Dual Avatar Trap; summons itself when a Dual Avatar falls on their turn.

Quick-Play: destroys your Dual Avatar and their card; draws or banishes.

Revives a Dual Avatar and adds a Token.
Copies a Dual Avatar Spell/Trap from the GY.
